summary: US and Israeli officials are finalizing plans for a massive bombing campaign targeting Iranian energy infrastructure, possibly this weekend, though President Trump has not yet given the final order. Iran's Foreign Ministry vowed to use all tools for legitimate defense against what it calls US aggression, including naval blockade and attacks on civilian infrastructure. Meanwhile, an Israeli officer was wounded in southern Lebanon, and Iranian drones and missiles targeted Kuwait and two tankers in the Gulf of Oman.
key_points: US and Israel planning intense bombing campaign against Iranian energy infrastructure, possibly this weekend, pending Trump's final order. (Source: @VahidOnline/77689)
Iranian Foreign Ministry declares use of all tools for legitimate defense against US threats, naval blockade, and attacks on civilian infrastructure. (Source: @naya_foriraq/86671)
IDF officer moderately wounded in southern Lebanon during overnight operational activity. (Source: @inon_yttach/9774)
Five Hamas weapon depots destroyed in Gaza overnight, including one near Shuhada al-Aqsa Hospital in Deir al-Balah. (Source: @shin_persian/8771)
Iranian missiles and drones attacked Kuwait and two tankers in Gulf of Oman; Kuwait intercepted several. (Source: @mamlekate/104055)
US State Department warns citizens in Middle East to prepare to leave region due to unpredictable escalation. (Source: @mamlekate/104055)
Israel at highest alert, senior officials consulting over weekend amid expectations of US military action against Iran. (Source: @SharghDaily/175690)
Jordan warns Iraq it will strike Iranian-backed militias if Jordan attacked, shares intelligence on militia plans. (Source: @N12chat/220172)

sections.executive_summary: US and Israeli officials are finalizing plans for a massive bombing campaign targeting Iranian energy infrastructure, possibly this weekend, though President Trump has not yet given the final order. Iran's Foreign Ministry vowed to use all tools for legitimate defense against what it calls US aggression, including naval blockade and attacks on civilian infrastructure. Meanwhile, an Israeli officer was wounded in southern Lebanon, and Iranian drones and missiles targeted Kuwait and two tankers in the Gulf of Oman.

points: Iran's Foreign Ministry stated Iran will use all tools for legitimate defense of its rights and national security, condemning US naval blockade, illegal threats, and attacks on civilian infrastructure as an "act of aggression" and UN Charter violation, while blaming the US for destabilizing the Strait of Hormuz and using ship passage claims as cover for military pressure. (Source: @naya_foriraq/86671)

CBS reports US and Israel preparing one of the most intense bombing campaigns against Iranian energy infrastructure — including power plants and refineries — with possible attacks over the weekend; Israel is coordinated with the US, but Trump has not issued the final order; Netanyahu presented three war options, one focused on ground supply routes, and high-level talks considered cutting electricity across Tehran. (Source: @VahidOnline/77689)

Russian electronic and satellite intelligence is being shared with Iran, enabling more precise targeting of US forces in air strikes, strengthening Iranian air defense against US attacks, and disrupting US-made weapons systems, according to US and European officials. (Source: @VahidOnline/77691)
Iranian government buildings in Hormozgan Province were ordered evacuated of personnel today, indicating anticipation of imminent strikes. (Source: @shin_persian/8772)

A plan to evacuate police stations nationwide has become serious, with at least 48 hours given for evacuation; in Nishapur, police station 13 Quds is being emptied with armored vehicles and vans moving in and out. (Source: @kianmeli1/90481, @rodast_omiddana/78486)

Iranian armed forces launched missile and drone attacks against Kuwait and two tankers in the Gulf of Oman on Saturday; Kuwait's army announced it intercepted several Iranian drones and missiles. (Source: @mamlekate/104055)
An IDF combat officer was moderately wounded during overnight operational activity in southern Lebanon and evacuated to hospital for treatment. (Source: @inon_yttach/9774)

Israel is at its highest alert level; senior political and security officials held consultations throughout the weekend (Saturday-Sunday) amid growing expectations of US military action against Iran; an Israeli official said Trump has not yet decided on the scope of a potential strike or whether Israel will participate in the first phase. (Source: @SharghDaily/175690)
A security source told Flash News that Israel is preparing for an American attack on Iran, with heightened alert and readiness in defense systems. (Source: @pkpoi/143490)

Five Hamas weapon depots were destroyed in overnight Israeli airstrikes across Gaza; the sites contained assault rifles, explosive devices, and anti-tank launchers; one depot was located next to Shuhada al-Aqsa Hospital in Deir al-Balah. (Source: @shin_persian/8771)
Four Israeli drones exploded near the Al-Zaytoun Sports Club southeast of Gaza City. (Source: @presstv/201181)

Netanyahu presented three war options to Trump during their meeting this week, including one focused on ground supply routes; Netanyahu also met with US Defense Secretary Hegseth. (Source: @VahidOnline/77689)
US and Israeli officials discussed a joint attack on Iran as early as this weekend. (Source: @yediotnews25/133470)

Five Hamas weapon depots were destroyed in overnight Israeli airstrikes across Gaza; the depots held assault rifles, explosive devices, and anti-tank launchers; one was located adjacent to Shuhada al-Aqsa Hospital in Deir al-Balah. (Source: @shin_persian/8771)
The IDF and Shin Bet stated the weapons were intended for attacks on Israeli forces and civilians and were destroyed to remove the threat. (Source: @shin_persian/8771)
Four Israeli drones exploded near the Al-Zaytoun Sports Club southeast of Gaza City, according to footage. (Source: @presstv/201181)
An IDF combat officer was moderately wounded during overnight operational activity in southern Lebanon and evacuated to hospital; the officer's family was notified. (Source: @inon_yttach/9774)
Red Alert Lebanon volunteers continue to provide round-the-clock alerts based on open sources and user reports to protect civilians. (Source: @redlinkleb/34192)

A drone attack targeted the outskirts of the village of Gachineh in Sulaymaniyah province, northern Iraq, with two drones; Iraq News reported the strike hit headquarters of separatist groups in Sulaymaniyah. (Source: @SharghDaily/175688)

A Jordanian official source told Al Arabiya that Amman passed a message to Baghdad warning it will strike Iranian-backed militias if Jordan is attacked; Jordan also shared intelligence on militia plans to attack Jordanian territory and expects Iraq to take steps to restrain those militias. (Source: @N12chat/220172)
An armed attack in the Kalar market in Sulaymaniyah province killed one person and injured another; the gunmen fled. (Source: @naya_foriraq/86634)

Iranian missiles and drones attacked Kuwait and two tankers in the Gulf of Oman; the Kuwaiti army announced it intercepted several Iranian drones and missiles at 0624Z (09:54 Tehran time). (Source: @mamlekate/104055, @shin_persian/8762)
The UKMTO issued Warning 101-26 for maritime security in the region. (Source: @shin_persian/8761)

The US State Department and diplomatic missions in several Middle East countries warned American citizens to exercise increased caution and consider departure due to rising regional tensions and potential unpredictable escalation. (Source: @mamlekate/104055)
